lines.dialogue: Tell me. How many nannies go around shakin’ their babies, d’you reckon?
A good, hard shake. Like trynna get ketchup out of a bottle. 1 percent? Less?
But they sell a coupla billion dollars worth of this shit worldwide. Goes to show. The bollocks you can make people swallow, if you get ‘em scared enough.
I’m not gonna piss you about, Hughie. I know what happened to Robin. Fuckin’ diabolical.
She wasn’t in the street. She was one step off the fuckin’ curb. And you didn’t take the pay-off. Respect that.
Butcher’s the name. People call me Billy. I was thinkin’ we could have a bit of a chat?
I can’t fuckin’ immigrate? There’s a big green crumpet out in the harbor that says different.
Oh? What do I look like?
Well, it’s right there in black an’ white. But if you wanna give a looksie up me bum to be sure, you go right ahead.
It’s what I can do for you, my son. Help you get payback for yer girl. You ain’t alone, Hughie, happens a lot more than you think. Supes lose over a hundred people a year to collateral damage --
It’s not that they ain’t strong, it’s that they don’t care. We’re just ants to them.
Might be the odd mention now an’ again, like with Robin. But there’s a lot more they don’t tell you -- that gets swept under the rug --
It ain’t obvious?

The movie tickets, an’ the lobbyists, an’ the fuckin’ shoes. But mostly, people like that cozy feeling Supes give ‘em. You got someone to swoop in and save the day for you, then you don’t gotta do it yourself. But you don’t know half the shit they’re up to. It’d curl your hair and straighten your curlies. But that’s where I come in. HUGHIE Come in... to do what? BUTCHER Spank the bastards, they ever step too far outta line. HUGHIE How do you spank a Supe? BUTCHER Ways an’ means. You don’t need a

lines.scene: EXT. ALLEY - OLD MONEY BUILDING - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: This is the last time, Harry.

lines.scene: INT. OLD MONEY BUILDING - PRIVATE CLUB - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: And now he’s the meat in the Manwich. Fuckin’ hypocrite. Like Bill Cosby in spandex.

lines.scene: INT. OLD MONEY BUILDING - PRIVATE CLUB - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Not yet.
Where’s the vid you rang me about?
Oi. Hughie. Monitor 2.
Question is, what are you gonna do about it?
Homelander’s the exception. Doesn’t drink, smoke. Fuckin’ saint. But the rest? Yeah, pretty much. Here, have a shufti at this --

Police log, night of Robin’s death. Couple bar fights, some cars got nicked. Know what’s not in there? No banks triggering any alarms. No one charged with robbery at Central Booking. A-Train stopped two bank robbers, my arse. Someone’s covering somethin’ up.

Whatever A-Train was doing that night. You said he looked scared. But what’s he got to be scared of? What did he mean, ‘he can’t stop?’ And what was in that bag? All sounds bleedin’ dodgy to me. So the big question is: where was he runnin’?
Ring Vought. Tell ‘em you’ll take the money, sign the NDA. But only if A-Train’s there in person when you do.

I dunno. Say you gotta shake his hand. For closure. They’ll invite you into the Seven Tower to meet him. Past their security. And then, my son, you are gonna stick a bug in the place. We’ll have a listen, really see what’s going on.
Hughie. Why do you think I came to you in the first place? For the good of me health?
No way they give me a pass.
It won’t.
I got a warrant. But that place is fire-walled and untappable and locked up tighter than a nun’s clunge. I couldn’t sneak in meself, not in a million years. But you can. Now calm down.
We’ve never had a go at the Seven before, not like this --
You saw him on that video. You heard what he said about her.
I’m gonna fuckin’ have you. You cunt.
You’re right. It is a terrible idea.
Boy, this is a shocker. Not expectin’ to see you again.
I dunno, mate. How do I know you ain’t gonna leg it like last night? How do I know you got the bottle?
You gonna see this through? To the end?
Right, then.

lines.scene: INT. DIVE BAR - BY THE BATHROOM - LATER
lines.dialogue: Oh yes, they will. And in the Tower, too. They’re not gonna wanna air this shit in public.

lines.scene: EXT. THE SEVEN TOWER/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Hughie. Two choices. One: go an’ whine to a shrink for the rest of your life, pop some Klonopin, maybe punch an A-Train doll. Two: stop bein’ such a cunt. What do you say?

lines.scene: EXT. BRYMAN AUDIO VISUAL/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Got its moments.

lines.scene: EXT. BRYMAN AUDIO VISUAL/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: How d’you mean? You gotta go back to work, yeah?

lines.scene: EXT. BRYMAN AUDIO VISUAL/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Hughie, you were brilliant. But that’s all I needed you for.

lines.scene: EXT. BRYMAN AUDIO VISUAL/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You did help. I got it from here. Cheers.

lines.scene: EXT. BRYMAN AUDIO VISUAL/INT. BUTCHER’S CAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You’re a good lad, Hughie. Not all that common in my line of work.

lines.scene: INT. BUTCHER’S CAR/EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS
lines.dialogue: Fuckin’ hell, Hughie, you got yourself made.

lines.scene: INT. BUTCHER’S CAR/EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS
lines.dialogue: Ah, well.
Hughie, run. Fuckin’ run! BUTCHER Let him be, you invisible cunt. TRANSLUCENT (O.S.) Who are you?
I’ll tell you who you are. A fuckin’ joke, mate.
Translucent doesn’t even mean ‘invisible,’ you silly twat. It means ‘semi-transparent.’
There you are.
Well, he ain’t movin’.
Nice one, Hughie. Well, come on. We gotta get him in the trunk.
Think you just offed a member of the Seven.
Yeah. I ain’t really a fed.
...they’re fucking. MOTHER’S MILK You get the chip out?
Well, well, well. What have we here?
Starlight. Don’t you just light up a room. You’re looking well.
That was awkward. But you know what they say: what doesn’t kill us, makes us stronger, eh? Now what brings you by?
Oh? And what does Vought’s Big Slapper have to say?
Well then, let’s have ourselves a dekko at this looney bin. Starlight, would you be amenable to joining us on this little caper?
I can guess.
How will they ever manage without a bony blonde Supe? Just get ‘em in and get the fuck back, yeah?
And don’t get caught.
I see ‘em.
I ain’t got no problem with you.
You said it, not me.
Fuck me. MOTHER’S MILK Open up, I need help. He’s gonna swallow his tongue, now open the goddam door!
Hello. Easy, son. No trouble from us, you just stroll on by, yeah?
No one’s gonna hurt you, lad. We’re your mates, ain’t we?
Gimme a fuckin’ hand!
Can you cauterize it?
We gotta get him to a doctor.
Well, we ain’t gonna just fuckin’ sit here and watch him bleed out!
They’ll have to sort themselves. Come on. ASHLEY Really, no one’s seen Starlight yet?
He’s here.
Sorry, mate. You just look like one a’ them poncy baton twirlers. MOTHER’S MILK Majorettes.
Right. A majorette.
Especially when it’s about Homelander.
What’d I say? Easy peasy.
Fuck him. We own his arse.
FBI. Need to commandeer your Hyundai. Bit of an emergency.
Long story, that.
In my other pants, too busy saving this one, but you can ring my boss --
Come on! You can cauterize it!
It won’t hold long. Come on.

Thank you. MOTHER’S MILK This really the time to go shopping? FRENCHIE One, why not? And two, this is good news. Perhaps we won’t have to fight anyone. MOTHER’S MILK What do you mean? FRENCHIE With some aerated propofol, some other odds and ends? I make a knockout bomb. Even for Supes.
Going as fast as I can.
Appreciate what you did back there.
And some sarcasm to stick the landing. Nice one. You didn’t have a choice.
Huh.
We need help!
What’d they say?
We ain’t got a day or two.
What?
L’Oreal for Kids “Strawberry Smoothie.” I seen the bottle. Hateful shit.
You know Hughie slathers Creamy Desitin on his bum every morning.
He’s mental, is all I’m saying.
Aye. He follows you around like a right little pup.
Not quite.
You bled all over the place like a right wanker, that’s what happened.
So that’s Stormfront. Thanks to Starlight, we know Noir just needs a fuckin’ tree nut. And A-Train? MOTHER’S MILK Got enough epinephrine here to explode the motherfucker’s heart.
That’s exactly what we’re gonna do.
Then we’ll top them, too. HUGHIE So that’s it -- we’re just Super Villains now? HUGHIE (CONT’D) Guys, come on. MOTHER’S MILK They attacked the country, Hughie. Fuck ‘em all.
Oi?
Guys, give her some fuckin’ air.
So Ryan ain’t on their Social Media. Least the cunts’re keeping him off TMZ for now.
Not sure. Stay here and rest up. I’m gonna shake a few trees.
Nah. Wasn’t as bad as that row we got in at the Spice World movie, eh?
It was an abomination against God and man. You’re my girl. I’ll get you your son back.
Uch. Fuck off, you cunts.
I assume you got a man out there, with a clean shot?
So I’ll pass on the fuckin’ hors d’oeuvres, we’ll get to it, yeah?
Yeah, right. That boy’s your only possible contingency against the cunt. Which don’t work, if they’re off playin’ Ward and the Beav. I can fix that.
Because you’re a ruthless bastard.
You turned a racist piece of shit into America’s Sweetheart. What word would you use?
Maybe you ain’t looked in a mirror lately, but she don’t bother you?
So just business, eh?
And what makes you think you can control Stormfront?
Alright then. I’ll get the boy away from Homelander.
Sorry, plausible deniability. But I’ll ring your guys when I got him, they zero in on this cell signal, here, scoop him up. Just do a better job fuckin’ hidin’ him next time, yeah?
No, not Becca. She stays with me.
Find him a new Mommy. I want my wife back. That’s the deal.
You say you just can’t do it. It’s the only way you can guarantee Ryan’s protection. She’d do anything to protect her kid, wouldn’t she?
Just tell me where he is, I’ll do the rest.
Easy tiger. So let me guess? Don’t got no witness? You got fuck all?
Then let’s get to it.
He natters on like a balmy old crone. Becca, look. You ain’t going with us.
It ain’t safe for you. And I can’t...
Anything.
Course I will.
I swear on Lenny’s soul.
I see her. We gotta go now, Frenchie. You close?
We gotta go.
M.M.’s gonna take you to a woman with the CIA --
I cut a deal with Stan Edgar.
I cut a deal. That when I got Ryan, I’d call Vought. They’d come take him away, you’d never see him again.
But fuck me, I couldn’t do it. I did make the call, mind you. But it ain’t what they’re countin’ on.
I was gonna sell you out. I might do it again. You want a cunt like that with your kid?
You just raise him up right, eh? I’ll make sure they never find you.
We’re outta time. C’mon. You gotta let me do this. This one thing.
BECCA!
You all right?
Thank you.
Not on your fucking life --
Let her GO!!!
That’s a good lad. You done good.
No no no no no. Hold on. Hold on. HELP! SOMEONE HELP! HELP US!
No.
I promised.
Here.
This was your Mum’s. It’s St. Christopher. She gave it to me long time ago, told me it’d keep me safe, and it has, mostly. Now your Mum’ll keep you safe.
Remember what I told ya.
Vought’s gonna want the kid back.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: You don’t fuckin’ say? Piss off.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I don’t need yer help.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: You ain’t even real.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Bargain?

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Just fuck off and let me die in peace, would you?

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Since you’re here, make yourself useful and fetch us a pint, would you, love? Don’t be a cunt, I’m fuckin’ dyin’.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Where’s Singer? He safe?

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Appreciate what you’re doing for me here, Grace.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Then give us me phone, luv. We got work to do.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: ...Hughie.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: Dead? You and me both.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: When I was a kid, I heard about this place in Nevada, a steakhouse where the birds get their baps out when bringin’ yer ribeye. Lenny pissed himself when I told him, thought it was the funniest thing he ever heard.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: We was gonna go someday but... funny what you think of when your time’s up. Do us a favor and go, wouldya? For me and Lenny.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: Hughie. I asked you something.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - INTERCUT
lines.dialogue: Magic. An’ tell The Boys I’m sorry. For... well, just tell ‘em I’m sorry. Cheers, Hughie.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Well, cunt’s outta the bottle. Now it gets interestin’.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Lemme guess. You gotta go an’ take a bullet for the geezer?

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: You got my text.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Desperate times. Glad you came.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Listen Ryan, we need to have a bit of a serious chin wag.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Don’t I know it. Mate, I wished myself dead more than I can count, now here I am, ‘n all I want is more time. But I ain’t got it, and I ain’t got time to ease you into this.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: You can’t go back to the Tower. You’re goin’ with Aunt Grace.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Now. Right now. Today.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: Look. When your Mom died. Which weren’t your fault. You heard what she said. She had me promise to keep you safe. That’s all I’m tryin’ to do here. So if you’re tellin’ me that the place you feel safest is with Homelander. Then I ain’t gonna stop you.

lines.scene: INT. THE TRUTHBOMB W/ FIRECRACKER SET - DAY
lines.dialogue: You ain’t too old for it?

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: That’s just... ain’t nothin’ you gotta worry about, mate.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: We’ll get to it.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Grace.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Grace!

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: I’m sorry, son, but that’s who Homelander truly is. He’s evil. A monster.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: And -- you’re the only one who can stop him.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: You can. You’re strong.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: There ain’t gonna be a next time for me, mate. Let’s just take a breather.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: We brought you here to help you.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: That ain’t how it is.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Grace, enough. Let him go.

lines.scene: INT. HAZLET SAFE HOUSE - BUTCHER’S ROOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: No!

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: No deals.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: No deals.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: Give us the virus. MOTHER’S MILK No fucking way.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: I wouldn’t hang about if I were you.

lines.scene: INT. VOUGHT FRESH FARMS FACILITY - DAY
lines.dialogue: By the way... you’re all fucking welcome.
